A comic reader for Android tablets and phones, inspired by Panels. Free software, made to feel like reading a real comic book.
Fwip is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0 or later. You can use, study, share and modify it; derived versions must stay under the same license.
Speech balloon and panel detection: YOLOv4-tiny model by Seeneva (Sergei Solodovnikov), GPL-3.0-or-later.
Fonts: Unbounded and Manrope, SIL Open Font License 1.1.
Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, LiteRT, Apache Commons Compress, XZ for Java, junrar and Coil (Apache 2.0, public domain and UnRAR licenses).

EPUB, Kindle files without DRM (MOBI, AZW3), FB2 and TXT open in Fwip. With comics and books together, a switch at the top of the library shows one or the other, and books can stand on a shelf by their spines.
Seven page colours, fonts made for reading (Literata, Bitter, Atkinson Hyperlegible, OpenDyslexic) or your own, size, spacing, margins, justified text and columns.
Like on a Kindle, the bottom line tells how long until the end of the chapter or the book, learned from how fast you read. Tap it to switch to page or percentage.

Books can now be read as a real book in a place: cover that opens, page edges that grow as you read, the curve of the paper and pages that turn under your finger. Turn it on with 3D in the reader.
A desk, a library, by the fire, mountains, a park, a rainy window, a beach at sunset or a starry night, each drawn or as a photo, with fire, leaves, rain and stars moving, and their own sound.
